title: Diagram
description: JSON Schema for a diagram — a functor D : J → C from a small index category J into a category C (Mac Lane 1971 Ch. III §1). The shape of J determines what kind of diagram (parallel pair, span, cospan, discrete, sequence, ...). The diagram's image must cover the index category — at least one object in J's image and at least one morphism if J has any. Uses contains/minContains to assert non-emptiness of the morphism cover via a JSON Schema 2020-12 cardinality assertion.

index-category.description: The small index category J shape — discrete, parallel-pair, cospan, span, simplex, etc.

image-functor.description: The functor D : J → C carrying the diagram. References a functor instance.

image-objects.description: The objects of the diagram — the images D(j) for j in Ob(J).

image-morphisms.description: The morphisms of the diagram — the images D(f) for f a morphism of J. Must contain at least one morphism (minContains: 1) for non-discrete diagrams; the contains constraint asserts cardinality at the JSON Schema 2020-12 level.
